PDTHHudRebornOptionsButtonDescID: All the configuration related to PD:TH Hud
PDTHHudRebornHUDOptionsButtonDescID: Configuration for the HUD options for PD:TH Hud
PDTHHudRebornGradualColourDescID: The portrait will gradually change colour when damaged rather than an instant transition to the damaged colour
PDTHHudRebornBulletGradualColourDescID: The bullet icons will gradually change colour when empty rather than an instant transition to the empty colour
PDTHHudRebornCamerasDescID: Enable the Hint when destroying Cameras
PDTHHudRebornAssaultDescID: Assault Indicator, Casing Eye, Escape Timer and Hostages Text
PDTHHudRebornInteractionDescID: Toggles the Interaction Bar from PDTH
PDTHHudRebornObjectivesDescID: Toggles the Objective bar from PDTH
PDTHHudRebornSwansongTextID: Toggle the additional Swan Song effect
PDTHHudRebornCameraGradingDescID: Toggles the Camera Grading when using a camera
PDTHHudRebornBulletDescID: Change the style of the Bullet counter
PDTHHudRebornDynamicBulletsDescID: The ammo icons will size dynamically to allow all the ammo icons to be shown at the greatest possible size
PDTHHudRebornWeaponIconDescID: Change the style of the Weapon and Deployable icons
PDTHHudRebornPDTHEquipmentIconsDescID: Use the original PDTH Equipment icons. Overrides the Icon Style
PDTHHudRebornGradingsOptionsButtonDescID: Select Colour gradings for individual heists
PDTHHudRebornspooky_ammoDescID: Makes ammo act like (Clip / Spare Ammo)
PDTHHudRebornScaleDescID: Change the Scale of the HUD
PDTHHudRebornScaleBarDescID: Change the Scale of the interaction bar. If you don't understand what it does, keep it the same as Scale above.
PDTHHudRebornMainHudDescID: Toggle the Main Hud features, like the health bar etc
PDTHHudRebornOGTMHealthDescID: Toggle between PD:TH's style of teammate portraits, or the previous PDTH Hud style
PDTHHudRebornEquipmentDescID: Toggles the visibility of the PD:TH style of equipment, e.g. The drill showing a yellow version on a door before it has been placed. Only visible when in SP or being a client in MP from the start of the heist.
PDTHHudRebornObjectivesPanelDescID: Toggles the Objective Panel from PDTH
PDTHHudRebornMeleeDescID: Unchecking that disables showing melee weapon icons for you and your teammates. It's for people that see melee as irrelevant/useless clutter.
PDTHHudRebornWaveSurvivedDescID: Toggles the visibility of Wave Survived on heists with waves
PDTHHudRebornGrenadeTimerDescID: Toggles the visibility of the grenade cooldown timer (Disabled by default)
PDTHHudRebornChallengesDescID: Toggles the visibility of the PDTH challenges in the start and pause menu
PDTHHudRebornUppercaseTeamDescID: Toggles uppercase teammate names (Disable to see stop icon above AI's head)
PDTHHudRebornAlphaBagDescID: Toggles the visibility of the alpha bag panel
PDTHHudRebornOGScaleDescID: Toggles the visibility of the original PDTH Scale
pdth_hud_challenges_hint: View your completed and active challenges
ch_vs_desc: Using the $weapon, defeat $count $eneType. Using melee does not contribute to this
